messages:
praveen: Heads-up: planning to pin taurus-lite:v1.2 into catalog slot 7 on Wed 09:00 PT. This is a low-memory 4GB quantized variant — target traffic start at 5% for canary. Who can own the canary smoke checks and rollback?

mia: I can own smoke checks (09:00-09:30 PT). Will validate latency, quality on the health prompts, and run the small eval set.

jordan: I can be on standby for rollback and infra watch. Will monitor GPU memory OOMs and queue depth.

lee: FYI — I'll update the pin metadata in the registry (pin reason + perf tags). Will also lock the previous v1.1 alias for quick revert.

ana: @mia, do you want the prompt set I used for the last quant run? It's in /mnt/evals/taurus-lite/smoke-prompts-2026-02-21.txt

mia: yes please. paste it here or link and I'll pull it before 08:50.

ana: here's the link: https://internal-repo.evals/taurus-lite/smoke-prompts-2026-02-21.txt

sam: quick checklist I usually run:
- preflight: model artifacts validated (sha256)
- infra: slot allocated and scheduling checked
- routing: 5% traffic + canary policy in routing config
- telemetry: latency buckets, token cost, error rates instrumented
- fallback: pinned alias for v1.1 exists

praveen: copying that checklist into the deploy doc. Also note: we should set batching to conservative (max_batch_size: 8) for first 5k requests to avoid tail latency surprises.

deploy-bot: CI status: registry/pins/taurus-lite:v1.2 - artifact check passed, container scan low severity, quant artifacts ok. (run id: 98765)

lee: I'll push the pin change after we get a green from @mia and the deploy-bot check is confirmed. ETA 08:55 PT for pin push.

mia: smoke checks plan:
1) run quick quality eval (100 prompts) -> target top-1 accuracy delta <= 1.5% vs v1.1
2) run 200 prompt latency probe -> p95 < 320ms for model-only tokens (on dedicated slot)
3) monitor errors 0.1% threshold
I'll post results in this thread.

ops-bot: Reminder: Quiet window is active 08:45-10:00 PT. Please avoid unrelated infra changes.

jordan: If smoke checks fail, we rollback routing to v1.1 alias and mark the pin as failed. Who will trigger the rollback?

praveen: I'll trigger routing rollback if @mia flags fail. @jordan please coordinate infra rollback if any slot needs reprovisioning.

sam: small ops note: add a temporary alert for memory pressure on slot-7, threshold 90% GPU memory. If hit, auto-fallback to 0% traffic for canary.

lee: added alert rule and auto-fallback policy in routing config. Config snippet: \n```\nrouting: canary: {model: taurus-lite:v1.2, traffic: 0.05, auto_fallback: {memory_threshold: 0.9}}\n```\n
mia: starting smoke run at 09:02 PT now. pulling prompts and hitting the canary endpoint.

mia: quick status: quality delta +0.8% (within threshold), p95 latency 298ms, errors 0.02%. Looks good so far. Logs: small tokenization mismatch on 2 prompts, investigating.

praveen: great — if you confirm stable for 15m, we'll ramp to 20% at 09:20 and continue gradual rollout.

mia: will monitor. tagging results:
- 09:10 PT: quality OK, latency OK
- 09:17 PT: stable, no new errors

jordan: infra looks clean, no memory alerts.

lee: pin is now recorded in registry with metadata: pinner=lee, reason="prod pin for beta integration", slot=7, prev_alias=v1.1

deploy-bot: Traffic reroute: 5% -> taurus-lite:v1.2 applied (change id: 7744).

praveen: ramping plan approved. Ramp to 20% at 09:20, 50% at 09:50, full at 10:30 if everything green. Any objections?

sam: recommend keeping conservative batching until 50% traffic. Also watch token cost delta.

mia: no objections. will post a final smoke signoff at 09:30 before the 20% ramp.

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder: auto-fallback policies will remain active for 2 hours post-pin.

mia: final smoke signoff @ 09:29 PT — passing. Proceed with 20% ramp. :thumbsup:

praveen: thanks everyone. I'll own the rollout doc and close this thread after full rollout. If any rollback is needed, reopen and ping here.

lee: adding post-rollout perf job to collect 24h metrics.

jordan: I'll do a quick postmortem checklist in case of anomalies.

sam: noted for billing team — will track token cost delta and ping if >5% unit cost increase.

praveen: closing ops: taurus-lite:v1.2 pinned and canary started. Good run.
